title: SukkaNurmi's ModPack
description: Modpack made for vanilla plus experience with friends and solo with some mods to help it to run on servers
body: Vanilla plus experience that stays farely true to vanilla with its gameplay but expands on world gen and struture spawns that feel vanilla in nature. its good for people like me who enjoy vanilla experience with little spice. Every upload is meant to add more modd, shaders and or texture packs (I own none of the mod, texturepacks or shaders).
